themes.name: Regulator dropped the case after money flowed
themes.description: A firm or founder facing SEC/CFTC action invests in, partners with or donates to a Trump venture, and the enforcement matter is dismissed, closed or settled.

themes.name: Gulf sovereign money and dual-role envoys
themes.description: UAE, Saudi and Qatari state-linked money flows to Trump-family or in-law ventures with little oversight. The people negotiating for the US in the region (Witkoff, Kushner) have family or personal money tied to the same Gulf investors.

themes.name: President appoints the regulator of the family business
themes.description: Trump nominates or oversees the heads of the SEC, CFTC and OCC, which regulate or license companies that pay or are owned by his family.

themes.name: President makes the law for markets the family is in
themes.description: Legislation and executive orders (GENIUS, CLARITY, Bitcoin reserve, prediction-market policy) land in exactly the sectors where the family holds stakes.

themes.name: Official favours follow the money
themes.description: Pardons, export approvals, arms sales, charters and amicus briefs arrive around the time counterparties enrich Trump ventures; presented as coincidence.

themes.name: The 'beat China' justification
themes.description: Family crypto and robotics ventures are defended as necessary so America wins the race against China.

themes.name: Insiders profit, retail investors lose
themes.description: Coins and stocks that paid the family billions are down 90%+ for the supporters who bought them.

themes.name: Family member hired as adviser for the name
themes.description: Companies in regulated or contract-dependent sectors put the president's sons on boards or advisory roles without being able to say what they do beyond 'narrative'.

themes.name: Government contracts near family-linked firms
themes.description: Companies the sons invest in or advise receive, or explicitly target, federal contracts and incentives.

themes.name: Secrecy and non-disclosure
themes.description: Material ties are hidden or quietly edited: the secret 49% stake, undisclosed MGX link, shell companies, an envoy with no disclosure duty, filing and website language removed.

themes.name: Blanket denials
themes.description: Every party denies corruption or quid pro quo: 'abides by all laws', 'chosen on its merits', 'career staffers', 'I don't know who he is', 'we treat all participants alike'.

themes.name: Monetizing the office, brand and access
themes.description: Selling access and the presidential brand directly: holder dinners, merch, a paid feed of market-moving posts, stock-moving truths, gifts.

themes.name: Narrative over product, circular deals
themes.description: Ventures with little or no product sell on the Trump story, and related parties sit on both sides of deals that inflate each other.

themes.name: Flood the zone: too much to follow
themes.description: The sheer volume and speed of deals prevents sustained scrutiny; the video's premise for aggregating everything.
